metaDescription: Order custom red golf tees for your brand. High-visibility color perfect for tournaments and corporate events. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Red golf tees stand out on the green, making them a smart choice for branding at tournaments and corporate outings. Their high-visibility color ensures your logo gets noticed against the grass, whether you're using standard 2-3/4 inch tees or the 4 Bio-composite Golf Tees with a ball marker. Add your logo via pad printing or hot stamping for a clean, durable finish that lasts through 18 holes.
